A.summary: A combines short, closely coupled PCIe routes with a nominal 85 Ω geometry, parallel power pours and local capacitor returns. The retention drill is present, and release depends on confirming the production stackup and edge processing.

B.summary: Two dedicated GND planes and nearby transition vias give B the strongest return paths. Long 0.25 mm feeds at the 3.3 V slot contacts reduce load margin, and the edge-drilled retention feature needs explicit fabrication treatment.

C.summary: C has excellent 12 V distribution, matched PCIe pairs and deliberate plane relief at the connector lands. The drill and profile omit the M.2 retention half-hole, a mechanical release blocker despite clean electrical DRC.

D.summary: Nine missing GND connections isolate connector returns, and several differential mates take different layers or widely separated paths. A long 12 V trace and the missing M.2 retention feature compound the release risk.

human_guess.why: Lane-specific rounded tuning, two length targets offset by about one via traversal, locally placed return vias and small residual power-route edits suggest iterative interactive routing.
